caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, ornately decorated keyboard instrument with a polished brown wood finish and elaborately carved legs. The main body of the instrument has gold decorative accents on the front, including floral patterns above the keyboard and circular gold designs along the border. The keyboard features alternating white and black keys. The lid is open and has a matching brown wood tone with gold clasps. The instrument stands on two intricately carved legs, ending in claw feet, and a horizontal support bar connects both legs. Below the main body, a lyre-shaped pedal mechanism in the center is visible. The image is signed “H. Castelin” in the lower right corner. The background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Piano Forte
